answer_text:
Here are reliable places to buy makeup online in Saudi Arabia (most deliver nationwide, often with Arabic/English sites and cash/card options):

## Dedicated beauty retailers (best overall selection)
- **Sephora Saudi Arabia** – Major brands, gift sets, fast shipping in many cities  
  https://www.sephora.sa  
- **Faces (Alshaya)** – Wide range of makeup, skincare, fragrances  
  https://www.faces.com/sa-en  
- **Nice One** – Very popular in KSA; lots of mid-range and trendy brands, frequent promos  
  https://niceonesa.com  
- **Golden Scent** – Makeup + fragrance; frequent discounts  
  https://www.goldenscent.com  
- **Ounass** – More luxury/curated brands, premium service  
  https://www.ounass.sa  

## Big marketplaces (good for deals; check seller authenticity)
- **Amazon.sa** – Huge selection; prefer “Sold by Amazon”/authorized sellers  
  https://www.amazon.sa  
- **Noon** – Lots of options and fast delivery; check seller ratings/official stores  
  https://www.noon.com/saudi-en  

## Brand official stores (best for authenticity)
Many brands ship to KSA via their own sites (availability varies), e.g.:
- **MAC Cosmetics**, **Huda Beauty**, **Fenty Beauty** (regional availability can change—look for KSA shipping and official partners).

## Pharmacies (great for derm/“clean” brands)
- **Nahdi Online**  
  https://www.nahdionline.com/en  
- **Al-Dawaa Pharmacy**  
  https://www.al-dawaa.com  

### Quick tips to avoid counterfeits
- Prefer **official retailers** (Sephora/Faces/Nice One) or **“Sold by Amazon”**.
- Avoid listings with **no batch code**, vague photos, or prices far below normal.
- Check return policy and seals on arrival.

If you tell me your **city (or if you need delivery to a specific area)** and the **brands/budget** you want (drugstore vs luxury), I can narrow it down to the best options and current deals.
